== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍警備兵員</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">移動できない。攻撃時は、戦闘力＝0で、防御時は、戦闘力＝4となる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">戦術や武器に長けたエリート兵士。デス・スター配属のタジス・ドゥアミンなどがその典型例で、重要拠点に配置されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Imperial Trooper Guard.

'''Lore''' — Elite soldiers skilled in tactics and weapons. Tajis Durmin, assigned to the Death Star, is a typical example. They are stationed at key positions.

'''Game text''' — Cannot move. Power is 0 when attacking and 4 when defending.

The Japanese and original English faces both specify power 0 when attacking and 4 when defending. The Japanese white-border photograph prints 1998 on the copyright line.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-imperialtrooperguard-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Trooper Guard]].</ref>
